rule: UI → command → owner → validation/permission → state/operation → event/receipt → projection → attribution → recovery/deep link

flows.ui_source: Settings manager Provider / Account / Model / Installation resource/detail action
validation_permission: secret redaction or FileSafe where applicable
flows.state_or_operation: Persistent setting mutation for requested policy; ObservableWork for external install/update/test/restore/cleanup; navigation-only and mutation-blocked for the missing-owner Server insertion.
flows.event_receipt: Typed completion/failure event with deterministic operation/receipt identity and simulation marker in concept.
flows.ui_projection: Requested/effective state, stage progression, source/ownership evidence, failure, rollback, and last-known-good projection.
flows.usage_diagnostic_attribution: Attribute external invocation/test/update work to the owning provider/tool/runtime; pure local preview/navigation has no Usage charge.
flows.concept_simulation_boundary: The concept mutates isolated browser demo state only and never performs login, installation, filesystem, provider, container, backup, or remote operations.

flows.ui_source: Installation detail → Update from official source
flows.state_or_operation: ObservableWork stages update in isolation, verifies invocation/ownership, and restores prior version on failure.
flows.event_receipt: Update staged / verification failed / rollback completed receipts.
flows.ui_projection: Selected/shadowed identity, progress, failure reason, rollback availability, final readiness.
flows.usage_diagnostic_attribution: Provider/tooling installation diagnostics only; never provider token usage.

provider_action_paths.first_acquisition: UI explicit Install/Setup -> provisional candidate command -> official-source and exact Host/Environment consent validation -> RuntimeResourceGovernor request -> ObservableWork -> verified installation generation -> receipt -> setup/auth deep link
provider_action_paths.select_existing: UI candidate selection -> provisional candidate command -> exact installation identity and expected binding revision -> binding mutation -> receipt -> readiness projection
provider_action_paths.authenticate: UI sign-in -> separate provisional candidate command -> provider-owned or approved PM auth flow -> auth receipt -> authentication projection; never acquisition
provider_action_paths.verify: UI or post-lifecycle verification -> provisional candidate command -> trusted procedure -> ObservableWork -> acquisition/auth/readiness results remain separate -> receipt
provider_action_paths.update: post-consent policy or explicit UI -> provisional candidate command -> RuntimeResourceGovernor admission -> ObservableWork -> stage/verify/activate or rollback -> receipt
provider_action_paths.repair: explicit recovery UI -> provisional candidate command -> same owner/admission/work contracts -> verify -> receipt or recovery link
provider_action_paths.rollback: explicit/verified failure path -> provisional candidate command -> last-good generation restore -> verify -> rolled_back or recovery_required receipt

corrected_candidate_wiring_contract.request_and_result_contract: Use the complete typed request and result fields in candidate-command-delta.json, including consent, continuation currentness, generation, coalescing, disabled reason, typed error, and recovery link.

owners.ObservableWork: sole work/progress/wait owner; cards and rows only project it
owners.RuntimeResourceGovernor: sole resource/admission owner; Settings requests/projects policy and never schedules/adjudicates; host enforcement uses this same contract

performance_wiring: Compact Home/search metadata first; only the selected manager hydrates.
Generation currentness fences stale hydration/search/provider continuations.
Caches and channels are byte bounded; lists mount at most 40 rows.
Inactive detail surfaces unsubscribe or decrement shared refcounts.
Projection changes are narrow and frame coalesced.
corrected_candidate_wiring_contract.native_validation: Deterministic old-hardware/network/resource fixtures are projections only; native Slint plus actual Ivy Bridge, Xeon, CPU, RAM, disk, and network validation remain unresolved gates and required review may run in bounded waves but may not be omitted.
corrected_candidate_wiring_contract.browser_boundary: No Playwright product/runtime/facade/compatibility/package/port/command/MCP/capture wiring. Browser checks are test evidence only and do not certify native Slint.
